summary: CenterPoint Energy filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Southern Indiana Gas and Electric Company entered a Bond Purchase Agreement with institutional private-placement investors for $260 million of first mortgage bonds issued in three tranches: $130 million 5.99% Series 2026A due 2031 sold October 20, 2026; $80 million 6.15% Series 2026B due 2033 funding December 15, 2026; and $50 million 6.33% Series 2027A due 2037 funding February 25, 2027. Bonds are secured ratably under the amended and restated mortgage indenture with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee. This is routine debt financing, not a special situation.
